title: Top Treadmills for Small Spaces & Home Gyms (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were taken from Tom’s Guide, CNET, OutdoorGearLab, and BarBend reviews. The best pick was chosen based on the most comprehensive feature set and versatility for small spaces.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no cost comparison is made.

verdict.line: Picture a busy home office where you can walk, hike, or run while working. The X24’s wide belt and iFit compatibility let you train at any pace, and its sturdy frame keeps it stable in tight rooms. The main catch is its higher price point compared to the other picks.
